name: wuyan-tongxing
description: 无烟同行：免登录、离线优先的 Android 戒烟记录与行为支持 App

scripts.build:cn-preview: pnpm build:h5 && npm --prefix deploy/tencent-cloudbase run build
scripts.sync:android: pnpm prepare:android && pnpm --filter @wuyan/android-shell exec cap sync android
scripts.build:android:maintainer-release: pnpm supply-chain && pnpm audit:sbom-osv:check && pnpm sync:android && node scripts/build-android.mjs
scripts.test:release: node --test scripts/build-android-public.test.mjs scripts/android-signing-policy.test.mjs scripts/gradle-wrapper.test.mjs scripts/verified-gradle-distribution.test.mjs scripts/android-apk-security-policy.test.mjs scripts/android-release-root-inventory.test.mjs scripts/osv-audit.test.mjs scripts/android-release-store.test.mjs scripts/source-snapshot-policy.test.mjs scripts/verify-zero-vulnerabilities.test.mjs scripts/android-device-test-results.test.mjs scripts/release-gate.test.mjs scripts/android-bootstrap-runtime.test.mjs scripts/spdx-license-expression.test.mjs scripts/verify-license-inventory.test.mjs scripts/generate-public-license-assets.test.mjs scripts/supply-chain-license-policy.test.mjs
scripts.audit:prod: pnpm audit --prod --audit-level low && npm --prefix deploy/tencent-cloudbase audit --audit-level low
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:release && pnpm verify:content && pnpm verify:repo && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.verify:ci: pnpm verify:peers && pnpm verify && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm verify:industrial && pnpm test:e2e:cn-preview && npm --prefix deploy/tencent-cloudbase run verify:package
